canonical_statement: A secondary endpoint was change from baseline in HbA1c at week 52.
Exploratory outcomes included body weight at week 18; fasting plasma glucose and blood pressure at weeks 18 and 52; HbA1c target attainment below 7%; and use of rescue therapy.
Safety endpoints included vital signs, laboratory parameters, adverse events, confirmed hypoglycemia, and events consistent with urinary tract and genital infections.

A planned sample of 555 participants (185/group) provided 90% power for the primary endpoint assuming 15% dropout and a two-sided significance level of 0.025 for each empagliflozin-placebo comparison.
